Hadith of Ibn Abbas, may God be pleased with him Imam Ahmad said: Abdullah bin Al-Walid told us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Duraid, Ismail bin Thauban told me, on the authority of Jabir bin Zaid, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: The evil eye is real, the evil eye is real and brings down the witch. Strange. Another chain of transmission Muslim said in his Sahih: Abdullah bin Abdul Rahman Al-Darimi told us, Muslim bin Ibrahim told us, Wahib told us, on the authority of Ibn Tawus, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, on the authority of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, who said: “The evil eye is real, and if anything could overtake destiny, it would be the evil eye. And when you are asked to wash, then wash.” He is the only one who transmitted it, not Al-Bukhari. Abdul Razzaq said, on the authority of Sufyan Ath-Thawri, on the authority of Mansur, on the authority of Al-Minhal bin Amr, on the authority of Saeed bin Jubair, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, used to seek refuge for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, saying: I seek refuge for you in the perfect words of God from every devil and pest, and from every evil eye. And he would say: This is how Ibrahim used to seek refuge for Isaac and Ishmael, peace be upon them. Al-Bukhari and the Sunan scholars transmitted it from the hadith of Al-Minhal with it. Hadith of Abu Umamah As`ad ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf, may God be pleased with him Ibn Majah said: Hisham ibn `Ammar told us, Sufyan told us, on the authority of Al-Zuhri, on the authority of Abu Umamah As`ad ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf, who said: “`Amir ibn Rabi`ah passed by Sahl ibn Hunayf while he was bathing and said: I have never seen anything like today, nor such hideous skin. It was not long before he was struck by a snake, and he was brought to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and it was said to him: ‘He caught Sahl lying dead.’ He said: ‘Who do you accuse?’ They said: ‘`Amir ibn Rabi`ah.’ He said: ‘Why would one of you kill his brother? If one of you sees something he likes in his brother, let him pray for blessings for him.’ Then he called for water and ordered `Amir to perform ablution, washing his face and hands up to the elbows, his knees, and the inside of his lower garment, and he ordered him to pour water over himself.” Sufyan said: Mu`mar said, on the authority of Al-Zuhri, and he ordered that the vessel be tipped over from behind him. Al-Nasa’i narrated it from the hadith of Sufyan ibn `Uyaynah and Malik ibn Anas, both of them from Al-Zuhri with it, and from the hadith of Sufyan ibn Uyaynah also narrated it on the authority of Muammar on the authority of Al-Zuhri on the authority of Abu Umamah: The vessel should be tipped over from behind. And from the hadith of Ibn Abi Dhi’b on the authority of Al-Zuhri on the authority of Abu Umamah: As’ad ibn Sahl ibn Hanif on the authority of his father on his authority. And from the hadith of Malik also on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Umamah ibn Sahl on the authority of his father on his authority. Hadith of Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri Ibn Majah said: Abu Bakr bin Abi Shaybah told us, Sa`id bin Sulayman told us, `Ibad told us, on the authority of Al-Jariry, on the authority of Abu Nadrah, on the authority of Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, used to seek protection from the eyes of the jinn and the eyes of mankind. When the two Mu`awwidhat were revealed, he took them and left everything else. Al-Tirmidhi and Al-Nasa’i narrated it on the authority of Sa`id bin Iyas Abu Mas`ud Al-Jariry, and Al-Tirmidhi said: Hasan. Another hadith from him Imam Ahmad said: Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith told us, my father told me, Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhaib told me, Abu Nadrah told me, on the authority of Abu Sa`id, “That Gabriel came to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and said: Are you ill, O Muhammad? He said: Yes. He said: In the name of God I perform ruqyah over you from everything that is harming you, and from the evil of every soul and eye that is harming you, and God heals you. In the name of God I perform ruqyah over you.” And he narrated it on the authority of Affan on the authority of Abd al-Warith, similarly. Muslim and the people of Sunan, except Abu Dawud, narrated it on the authority of Abd al-Warith with it. Imam Ahmad also said: Affan told us, Wahib told us, Dawud told us, on the authority of Abu Nadra, on the authority of Abu Saeed or Jabir ibn Abdullah, “That the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, fell ill, so Gabriel came to him and said, ‘In the name of God, I perform ruqyah over you from everything that is harming you, from every envier and evil eye, and God will heal you.’” It was also narrated by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Tafawi, on the authority of Dawud ibn Abi Nadra, on the authority of Abu Saeed, on its authority. Abu Zur’ah al-Razi said: Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith narrated on the authority of his father, on the authority of Abd al-Aziz, on the authority of Abu Nadra, and on the authority of Abd al-Aziz, on the authority of Anas, with a similar meaning, and both are authentic. Hadith of Abu Hurairah (may God be pleased with him Imam Ahmad said: Abd al-Razzaq told us, Ma'mar told us, on the authority of Hammam ibn Munabbih, who said: This is what Abu Hurairah told us, on the authority of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him), who said: The evil eye is real. Both of them narrated it from the hadith of Abd al-Razzaq. Ibn Majah said: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah told us, on the authority of Ismail ibn Ulayyah, on the authority of al-Jariry, on the authority of Mudharib ibn Hazn, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: The evil eye is real. He was the only one who narrated it. Ahmad narrated it on the authority of Ismail ibn Ulayyah, on the authority of Saeed al-Jariry, and Imam Ahmad said: Ibn Numair told us, Thawr - meaning Ibn Yazid - told us, on the authority of Makhul, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) said: The evil eye is real, and Satan and the envy of the sons of Adam attend to it. Ahmad said: Khalaf ibn al-Walid told us, Abu Ma'shar told us, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Qays: Abu Hurairah was asked: Did you hear the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) say: “Superstition is in three things: in a dwelling, a horse, and a woman?” He said: I said, then, should I say about the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, something he did not say, but I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, say, The most truthful omen is the omen, and the evil eye is true. The hadith of Asma bint Umays Imam Ahmad said: Sufyan narrated to us, on the authority of Amr ibn Dinar, on the authority of Urwah ibn Amir, on the authority of Ubayd ibn Rifa’ah az-Zurqi, who said: “Asma said, ‘O Messenger of God, the children of Ja’far are afflicted by the evil eye. Should I recite ruqyah for them?’ He said, ‘Yes, for if anything could overtake destiny, it would be the evil eye.’” This is how it was narrated by at-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah from the hadith of Sufyan ibn Uyaynah with this chain of transmission. It was also narrated by at-Tirmidhi and an-Nasa’i from the hadith of Abd al-Razzaq, on the authority of Muammar, on the authority of Ayyub, on the authority of Urwah ibn Dinar, on the authority of Urwah ibn Amir, on the authority of Ubayd ibn Rifa’ah, on the authority of Asma bint Umays with this chain of transmission. At-Tirmidhi said: Hasan saheeh. Hadith of Aisha (may God be pleased with her Ibn Majah said: Ali ibn Abi Al-Khasib told us, Wakee’ told us, on the authority of Sufyan and Mis’ar, on the authority of Ma’bad ibn Khalid, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Shaddad, on the authority of Aisha may God be pleased with her that the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) commanded her to seek protection from the evil eye. Al-Bukhari narrated it on the authority of Muhammad ibn Kathir, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Ma’bad ibn Khalid, and Muslim included it on the authority of Sufyan and Mis’ar, both on the authority of Ma’bad, on his authority. Then Ibn Majah said: Muhammad ibn Bashar told us, Abu Hisham Al-Makhzumi told us, Wahib told us, on the authority of Abu Waqid, on the authority of Abu Salamah ibn Abd Al-Rahman, on the authority of Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: Seek refuge in God, for the evil eye is real. He is the only one who narrated it. Abu Dawud said: Jarir told us, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Ibrahim, on the authority of Al-Aswad, on the authority of Aisha, who said: The one who cast the evil eye would be ordered to perform ablution and wash the one who had been affected by it. I said likewise that Ahmad narrated it on the authority of Hasan bin Musa and Husayn bin Muhammad on the authority of Sinan that Ibn Hasana told him on the authority of his father on the authority of Abu Hurayrah that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: There is no inspiration, and the evil eye is real, and the most truthful omen is the omens. Hadith of Sahl ibn Hanif Imam Ahmad said: Husayn ibn Muhammad told us. Abu Uwais told us. Al-Zuhri narrated to us on the authority of Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf, that his father told him: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, went out and they walked with him towards Mecca until they reached the ravine of Al-Kharrar in Al-Juhfah. Sahl ibn Hunayf washed himself. He was a white man with a handsome body and skin. Amir ibn Rabi’ah, the brother of Banu ‘Adi ibn Ka’b, looked at him while he was washing and said: ‘I have never seen anything like today, nor skin as hidden.’ Sahl became weak and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was approached and it was said to him: ‘O Messenger of God, what do you think of Sahl? By God, he does not raise his head nor does he recover.’ He said: ‘Do you accuse anyone of him?’ They said: ‘Amir ibn Rabi’ah looked at him.’ The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, called Amir and became angry with him and said: ‘Why would one of you kill his brother? Why don’t you, when you see something that pleases you, bless him?’ Then he said: ‘Gaze for him.’ He washed his face, hands, elbows, knees, the tips of his feet, and the inside of his lower garment in a cup. Then he poured that water over him. A man poured it over his head and back from behind him, then he poured it over his head and back from behind him. The cup was behind him, so he did that and Sahl went with the people without any problem.” Hadith of Amir bin Rabi’ah Imam Ahmad said in his Musnad: We were told by Wakee’, we were told by my father, we were told by Abdullah bin Isa, on the authority of Umayyah bin Hind bin Sahl bin Hunaif, on the authority of Ubaydullah bin Amir, who said: Amir bin Rabi’ah and Sahl bin Hunaif set out intending to perform ablution. He said: They set out looking for wine. He said: Amir put down the woolen cloak he was wearing, and I looked at him and caught his eye. He went down into the water to bathe. He said: I heard a crackling sound in the water, so I went to him and called out to him three times, but he did not answer me. So I went to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and informed him. He said: He came walking and waded into the water, and it was as if I could see the whiteness of his shins. He said: He struck his chest with his hand and then said: O God, turn away from him its heat and its cold and its rain. He said: He stood up, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: If one of you sees something he likes in his brother, in himself, or in his wealth, then let him ask for blessings, for the evil eye is real. Hadith of Jabir Al-Hafiz Abu Bakr Al-Bazzar said in his Musnad: Muhammad bin Muammar narrated to us, Abu Dawud narrated to us, Talib bin Habib bin Amr bin Sahl Al-Ansari, who is called Ibn Al-Dajji’, the companion of Hamza, may God be pleased with him, narrated to me Abdul Rahman bin Jabir bin Abdullah, on the authority of his father, who said: “The Messenger of God, peace and blessings be upon him, said: ‘Most of those who die from my nation after the Book of God, His judgment and decree are because of the souls.’” Al-Bazzar said: He meant the evil eye. He said: We do not know of this hadith being narrated from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, except with this chain of transmission. I said: Rather, it has been narrated from Jabir through another chain of transmission. Al-Hafiz Abu Abdul Rahman Muhammad bin Al-Mundhir Al-Harawi, known as Shukr, said in his book Al-Aja’ib, which contains important and strange benefits: Al-Ramadi narrated to us, Ya’qub bin Muhammad narrated to us, Ali bin Abi Ali Al-Hashemi narrated to us, Muhammad bin Al-Munkadir narrated to us, on the authority of Jabir bin Abdullah, “The Messenger of God, peace and blessings be upon him, said: ‘The evil eye is real, for it leads a man to the grave and a camel to the cooking pot. Most of the destruction of my nation is because of the evil eye.’” Then he narrated it on the authority of Shu`ayb ibn Ayoub, on the authority of Mu`awiyah ibn Hisham, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, on the authority of Jabir, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: A man may enter the grave with an eye, and a camel may enter the cooking pot. This chain of transmission is all trustworthy, but it was not included in the Sahih. Hadith of Abdullah bin Amr Imam Ahmad said: Qutaybah told us, Rashdin bin Saad told us, on the authority of Al-Hasan bin Thauban, on the authority of Hisham bin Abi Ruqayyah, on the authority of Abdullah bin Amr, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: There is no contagion, no bad omen, no evil eye, no envy, and the evil eye is real. Ahmad alone transmitted it. Hadith on the authority of Ali Al-Hafiz Ibn Asakir narrated on the authority of Khaithama bin Sulaiman Al-Hafiz, who said: Ubaid bin Muhammad Al-Kashuri told us, Abdullah bin Abdullah bin Abd Rabbih Al-Basri told us on the authority of Abu Raja’ on the authority of Shu’bah, on the authority of Abu Ishaq, on the authority of Al-Harith, on the authority of Ali, may God be pleased with him, “That Gabriel came to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and found him sad, so he said: O Muhammad, what is this sadness that I see on your face? He said: Al-Hasan and Al-Hussain have been afflicted by the evil eye. He said: He spoke the truth about the evil eye, for the evil eye is real, so why don’t you protect them with these words? He said: What are they, O Gabriel?” He said: Say: O God, Possessor of the mighty power and the ancient favor, Possessor of the noble face, Possessor of the perfect words and the answered supplications, save al-Hasan and al-Husayn from the souls of the jinn and the eyes of mankind. So the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said it, and they stood playing in front of him. The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: Protect yourselves, your women, and your children with this incantation, for no one has ever sought protection with anything like it. Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi said: Abu Raja Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Hanti from the people of Tustar was the only one who narrated it. Ibn Asakir mentioned him in the biography of Tarad ibn al-Husayn in his history. And the Almighty said: {And they say: He is mad} meaning they look down on him with their eyes and hurt him with their tongues and they say: He is mad, meaning because he came with the Qur’an. God the Almighty said: {And it is not but a reminder to the worlds} [the end of the interpretation of Surah Nun]. And to God be praise and thanks.
